keepInMind.title: Keep in mind
keepInMind.body: Some components on this site are inspired by or recreated from existing work across the web. I'm not here to take credit; just to learn, experiment, and sometimes push things a bit further. If something looks familiar and I forgot to mention you, <link>reach out</link> and I'll fix that right away.
